scorecard.rationale: No controlled study isolates virgin coconut oil for apathy severity. The Parkinson baseline figure (MVP-2024) plots only an unquantified tile for motivation/initiative without oil grade, adjustment, or error limits. The Parkinson ketogenic MCT feeding study (PMID38561682) found no clear between-group diary apathy difference without isolating virgin coconut oil, and KIM (NCT05469997) reported no post-diet apathy comparison. The claim therefore moves from legacy 51 to open. The coconut oil survey outcome is the same overall PRO-PD composite cited in the gut microbiome review. Neither gives an apathy coefficient or identifies virgin-grade oil.
